scope: overtaking (passing another vehicle, and being passed)

vocabulary.definition: Changing lanes to move past a slower vehicle.
Designated areas that allow pedestrians to safely cross roads where there are no traffic lights, identified by specific signs, overhead yellow lights, and pavement markings.
A road where traffic travelling in opposite directions is separated by a median strip.

rules.title: General safety requirement
rules.when: the PASSER is not sure they can PASS without danger to themselves or others
rules.action: overtake and pass another vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN the PASSER is not sure they can PASS without danger to themselves or others, the PASSER MUST NOT overtake and pass another vehicle.

rules.title: No passing of snow plows
rules.when: the vehicle to be passed is a moving snow plow
rules.action: pass
rules.statement: WHEN the vehicle to be passed is a moving snow plow, the PASSER MUST NOT pass.

rules.title: Signalling and checking before passing
rules.when: preparing to PASS
rules.action: use a left-turn signal AND check that the way is clear ahead and behind before moving into the passing lane
rules.statement: WHEN preparing to PASS, the PASSER MUST use a left-turn signal AND check that the way is clear ahead and behind before moving into the passing lane.

vague_terms.explanation: no specific distance or gap defined

rules.title: Watch for hidden small vehicles
rules.when: performing a PASS
rules.action: watch for bicycles and small vehicles that may be hidden from view in front of the vehicle being passed
rules.statement: WHEN performing a PASS, the PASSER MUST watch for bicycles and small vehicles that may be hidden from view in front of the vehicle being passed.

rules.title: Watch for entering traffic
rules.when: performing a PASS
rules.action: watch for vehicles that may be turning left in front of the PASSER AND vehicles or pedestrians entering the road from another road or driveway
rules.statement: WHEN performing a PASS, the PASSER MUST watch for vehicles that may be turning left in front of the PASSER AND vehicles or pedestrians entering the road from another road or driveway.

rules.title: Returning to lane
rules.when: overtaking is complete
rules.action: signal the intent to move back into the original lane AND wait until the entire front of the passed vehicle is visible in the inside mirror before making the lane change
rules.statement: WHEN overtaking is complete, the PASSER MUST signal the intent to move back into the original lane AND wait until the entire front of the passed vehicle is visible in the inside mirror before making the lane change.

rules.title: No racing during pass
rules.when: the vehicle being passed speeds up
rules.action: race the vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN the vehicle being passed speeds up, the PASSER MUST NOT race the vehicle.
rules.note: The rule also states the PASSER should return to the original lane.

rules.title: No passing near pedestrian crossover
rules.when: within 30 metres of a PEDESTRIAN CROSSOVER
rules.action: pass any vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN within 30 metres of a PEDESTRIAN CROSSOVER, the PASSER MUST NOT pass any vehicle.

rules.title: No passing left of centreline near structures
rules.when: within 30 metres from a bridge, viaduct or tunnel
rules.action: pass left of a centreline
rules.statement: WHEN within 30 metres from a bridge, viaduct or tunnel, the PASSER MUST NOT pass left of a centreline.

rules.title: No passing on crests or curves
rules.when: approaching the crest of a hill OR on a curve where vision of oncoming traffic is obstructed AND there is not enough clear distance ahead to pass in safety
rules.action: attempt to pass
rules.statement: WHEN approaching the crest of a hill OR on a curve where vision of oncoming traffic is obstructed AND there is not enough clear distance ahead to pass in safety, the PASSER MUST NOT attempt to pass.

vague_terms.term: not enough clear distance ahead to pass in safety

rules.title: Passing parked vehicles
rules.when: passing parked vehicles
rules.action: watch carefully for people suddenly opening doors or for doors opened to load and unload
rules.statement: WHEN passing parked vehicles, the PASSER SHOULD watch carefully for people suddenly opening doors or for doors opened to load and unload.

rules.title: Passing motorcycles and bicycles
rules.when: passing motorcycles, bicycles, limited-speed motorcycles or mopeds
rules.action: change lanes to pass
rules.statement: WHEN passing motorcycles, bicycles, limited-speed motorcycles or mopeds, the PASSER MUST change lanes to pass.
rules.note: The handbook specifies that these users may pull to the side of their lane to avoid hazards, which should not be taken as an invitation to pass in the same lane.

rules.title: Cooperating with the passer
rules.when: faster traffic wants to pass
rules.action: move to the right and let it pass in safety
rules.statement: WHEN faster traffic wants to pass, the DRIVER being passed MUST move to the right and let it pass in safety.

rules.title: Being passed on undivided road
rules.when: being passed on an undivided road where the passing driver has pulled into the opposite lane
rules.action: move closer to the right side of the lane AND be prepared to slow down
rules.statement: WHEN being passed on an undivided road where the passing driver has pulled into the opposite lane, the DRIVER being passed MUST move closer to the right side of the lane AND be prepared to slow down.
rules.note: This is to let the passing driver get in front more quickly to prevent a collision.

rules.title: Truck passing lanes
rules.when: driving in the truck passing lane (the lane to the right of the far left lane) AND a truck wants to pass
rules.action: move into the right-hand lane as soon as possible
rules.statement: WHEN driving in the truck passing lane AND a truck wants to pass, the DRIVER MUST move into the right-hand lane as soon as possible.
rules.note: Applies to high-speed roads with three or more lanes in each direction where trucks are not allowed in the far left lane.

rules.title: Headlight use when approaching
rules.when: approaching a vehicle from behind at night to pass
rules.action: switch headlights to low beams
rules.statement: WHEN approaching a vehicle from behind at night to pass, the PASSER MUST switch headlights to low beams.

rules.title: Headlight use when alongside
rules.when: moving alongside the vehicle being passed at night
rules.action: switch on high beams
rules.statement: WHEN moving alongside the vehicle being passed at night, the PASSER MUST switch on high beams.
rules.note: This is to see more of the road ahead.

rules.title: Returning to lane at night
rules.when: the entire front of the passed vehicle is visible in the rear view mirror at night
rules.action: signal AND pull back into the right lane
rules.statement: WHEN the entire front of the passed vehicle is visible in the rear view mirror at night, the PASSER MUST signal AND pull back into the right lane.

rules.title: Passing on the right shoulder
rules.when: passing a vehicle turning left AND the shoulder is paved
rules.action: drive on the right shoulder to pass
rules.statement: WHEN passing a vehicle turning left AND the shoulder is paved, the PASSER MAY ONLY drive on the right shoulder to pass.

rules.title: No passing on left shoulder
rules.when: passing on the left shoulder
rules.action: pass
rules.statement: WHEN passing on the left shoulder, the PASSER MUST NOT pass, regardless of whether the shoulder is paved.

rules.title: Passing on the right
rules.when: on multi-lane roads OR one-way roads OR overtaking a streetcar OR overtaking a left-turning vehicle
rules.action: pass on the right
rules.statement: WHEN on multi-lane roads OR one-way roads OR overtaking a streetcar OR overtaking a left-turning vehicle, the PASSER MAY pass on the right.

rules.title: Caution when passing on right
rules.when: driving in the left most lane with a slower vehicle in front
rules.action: suddenly change lanes and pass on the right
rules.statement: WHEN driving in the left most lane with a slower vehicle in front, the PASSER SHOULD NOT suddenly change lanes and pass on the right.
rules.note: The driver in front may move to the right at the same time as the PASSER.
